mainTopic: When a טמא נזיר may bring his offerings: רבי עקיבא and רבי טרפון on a late shave, רבא on immersion, and אביי's challenge about immersion and sunset
overview: The משנה describes the shaving of a נזיר who became טמא from a dead body. He is sprinkled on the third and seventh days, shaves on the seventh, and brings his offerings on the eighth. רבי עקיבא rules that even if he shaves late, on the eighth, he brings his offerings that same day. רבי טרפון challenges this from a מצורע, who must wait a day. רבי עקיבא answers that the נזיר's purity depends on his days, while the מצורע's purity depends on his shaving. The גמרא asks whether רבי טרפון accepted this, and a teaching of הלל seems to show he did not. רבא answers that הלל speaks of a נזיר who did not immerse on the seventh. אביי then reports that the group of רב נתן בר הושעיא read the פסוק about a זב to mean he may come with his offerings only after immersing and waiting for sunset, and he challenges them that the same reading would apply to the impure נזיר. That discussion continues on the next amud.

steps.title: The order of the impure nazir's shaving
steps.stepSummary: The משנה lays out the schedule for a טמא נזיר: sprinkling on days 3 and 7, shaving on day 7, offerings on day 8. רבי עקיבא adds that if he shaved on day 8, he brings his offerings that same day.
steps.simpleTranslation: MISHNA: How is the shaving for impurity done? He is sprinkled on the third and seventh days, shaves on the seventh, and brings his offerings on the eighth. If he shaved on the eighth, he brings his offerings that same day. This is the view of רבי עקיבא.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה explains the normal order of the shaving for a נזיר who became טמא. It then gives רבי עקיבא's rule for a נזיר who shaved one day late.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The usual order is to shave on day 7 and bring the offerings on day 8. רבי עקיבא's new point is that a late shave does not push the offerings off. The נזיר can shave and bring his offerings together on day 8.

keyTerms.meaning: The shaving a נזיר does after becoming impure
Sprinkling the purifying water of the פרה אדומה

phrases.english: MISHNA
The shaving of impurity, how is it done?
He would be sprinkled on the third and on the seventh days
and he shaves on the seventh
and brings his offerings on the eighth.
And if he shaved on the eighth
he brings his offerings on that same day
these are the words of Rabbi Akiva.

steps.mimraCoreRuling: A טמא נזיר shaves on day 7 and brings his offerings on day 8. According to רבי עקיבא, if he shaved on day 8, he brings his offerings that same day.

steps.title: רבי טרפון compares the nazir to a metzora
steps.stepSummary: רבי טרפון challenges רבי עקיבא: a מצורע who shaves on the eighth must wait until the ninth, so why should a נזיר be different?
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי טרפון said to him: What is the difference between this case and a מצורע?
steps.whatsHappening: רבי טרפון pushes back on רבי עקיבא's ruling by pointing to the case of a מצורע.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A מצורע also shaves on day 7 and brings offerings on day 8. If a מצורע shaves late, he waits another day for his offerings. רבי טרפון asks why the נזיר should not follow the same pattern.

keyTerms.meaning: A person with צרעת who goes through a purification process

phrases.english: Rabbi Tarfon said to him
What is the difference between this one and a metzora?
phrases.notes: A מצורע who shaves on the eighth brings his offerings only on the ninth, so רבי טרפון expects the same here.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges רבי עקיבא's ruling from step 1
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי עקיבא's rule that a נזיר who shaved on day 8 brings his offerings that same day
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A מצורע has a similar shaving-and-offering schedule but must wait a day if he shaves late, so the נזיר should be the same.

steps.title: רבי עקיבא explains the difference
steps.stepSummary: רבי עקיבא answers that the נזיר becomes pure by counting his days, while the מצורע becomes pure only through his shaving and then needs sunset before he can bring an offering.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to him: This one's purity depends on his days, while a מצורע's purity depends on his shaving. And a מצורע does not bring an offering unless the sun has set after his purification.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי עקיבא answers רבי טרפון by showing that the two cases work differently.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The נזיר immerses on day 7 like anyone who is טמא from a dead body, so he is already fully pure on day 8 and the shaving does not affect his purity. The מצורע's purity starts only with his shaving and immersion, and he must wait for sunset before he can bring an offering. Offerings are not brought at night, so his offerings wait until the next day.

keyTerms.meaning: Depends on his days (counting the days)
One whose sun has set after immersing, so his purity is complete

steps.whatToRemember: A נזיר is pure through his days, so a late shave does not delay his offerings. A מצורע is pure through his shaving, so a late shave pushes his offerings to the next day.

phrases.english: He said to him
This one, his purity depends on his days
and a metzora, his purity depends on his shaving.
And he does not bring an offering

phrases.aramaic: אֶלָּא אִם כֵּן הָיָה מְעוֹרַב שֶׁמֶשׁ
phrases.english: unless the sun has set for him.

steps.terutzHavaAmina: The נזיר and the מצורע have the same pattern, so a late shave should delay both.
steps.terutzMaskana: The נזיר is already pure from his days, but the מצורע becomes pure only through shaving and needs sunset first.

steps.title: Did רבי טרפון accept the answer?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks whether רבי טרפון accepted רבי עקיבא's explanation.
steps.simpleTranslation: GEMARA: Did he accept it from him or not?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא opens by asking whether רבי טרפון agreed with רבי עקיבא after hearing his answer. This sets up the next step, which tries to answer the question.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה ends with רבי עקיבא's answer and does not tell us how רבי טרפון responded. The גמרא wants to know whether the disagreement ended there or continued.

keyTerms.meaning: The Talmud's discussion of the משנה

phrases.english: GEMARA
Did he accept it from him or not?
phrases.notes: He is asking whether רבי טרפון accepted רבי עקיבא's answer.

steps.sheelahInformationSought: Whether רבי טרפון accepted רבי עקיבא's distinction

steps.title: Proof from Hillel that he did not accept
steps.stepSummary: הלל taught that a נזיר who shaved on the eighth brings his offerings on the ninth. If רבי טרפון had accepted רבי עקיבא's view, the offerings would be on the eighth. So it seems רבי טרפון did not accept it.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: הלל taught that if he shaved on the eighth, he brings his offerings on the ninth. If you think רבי טרפון accepted the answer, the נזיר should bring his offerings on the eighth!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a teaching of הלל to try to show that רבי טרפון kept his own opinion.
steps.deeperAnalysis: הלל's teaching delays the offerings to day 9, which matches רבי טרפון's original view. Since no one would hold that view if רבי טרפון had given it up, it looks like he never accepted רבי עקיבא's answer.

keyTerms.meaning: And if it enters your mind

phrases.english: Come and hear
that Hillel taught:
If he shaved on the eighth
he brings his offerings on the ninth.
And if it should enter your mind
that he accepted it from him,
let him bring his offerings on the eighth!

steps.confusionAlert: This הלל is not the famous הלל from the time of שמאי. He is a later teacher.
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Tries to answer the question in step 4
steps.raayaObject: That רבי טרפון did not accept רבי עקיבא's view
steps.raayaSupportSource: הלל's teaching that a נזיר who shaved on day 8 brings his offerings on day 9

steps.title: רבא: the two sources describe different cases
steps.stepSummary: רבא rejects the proof. The משנה is speaking of a נזיר who immersed on the seventh, so he can bring his offerings on the eighth. הלל is speaking of one who did not immerse on the seventh, so he must wait until the ninth.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבא said: It is not difficult. This one is where he immersed on the seventh, and that one is where he did not immerse on the seventh.
steps.whatsHappening: רבא shows that הלל's teaching does not prove that רבי טרפון rejected רבי עקיבא's answer.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A נזיר who immersed on day 7 is fully pure on day 8 and can bring his offerings that day, as רבי עקיבא says. A נזיר who did not immerse until day 8 must wait for sunset, so his offerings move to day 9. Both rulings can be true together, so רבי טרפון may well have accepted רבי עקיבא's answer.
steps.whatToRemember: What matters is when the נזיר immersed. If he immersed on day 7, he brings his offerings on day 8 even if he shaved on day 8. If he did not immerse until day 8, he brings them on day 9.

phrases.english: Rava said: It is not difficult.
This is where he immersed on the seventh,
that is where he did not immerse on the seventh.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the proof from הלל in step 5
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The proof that רבי טרפון did not accept רבי עקיבא's answer
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The proof assumed both sources describe the same case, but they differ on whether the נזיר immersed on day 7.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: הלל's teaching does not prove that רבי טרפון rejected רבי עקיבא's view, because it speaks of a נזיר who did not immerse on day 7.

steps.title: אביי reports how the group of רב נתן בר הושעיא read the פסוק about the זב
steps.stepSummary: The group of רב נתן בר הושעיא taught that a זב may come to bring his offerings only after he has immersed and waited for sunset.
steps.simpleTranslation: אביי said: I found the group of רב נתן בר הושעיא sitting and saying: "And he shall come before ה׳ to the entrance of the אהל מועד and give them to the כהן." When does he come? If he immersed and waited for sunset, yes. If he did not immerse and wait for sunset, no.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי tells us about a teaching he heard about the זב, the man with an impure discharge. This sets up the next two moves.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק says the זב 'comes' to the entrance of the אהל מועד with his offerings. The group reads this as a condition: he may come only after he has immersed and the sun has set. If either is missing, he may not come.

keyTerms.meaning: A man who has an impure bodily discharge and must count seven clean days, immerse, and bring offerings on the eighth
Sunset; waiting for the sun to set after immersing
The Tent of Meeting, standing for the place where offerings are brought

phrases.english: Abaye said:

phrases.aramaic: אַשְׁכַּחְתִּינְהוּ לְחַבְרֵיהּ דְּרַב נָתָן בַּר הוֹשַׁעְיָא
phrases.english: I found the group of Rav Natan bar Hoshaya
sitting and saying:

phrases.aramaic: ״וּבָא לִפְנֵי ה׳ אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד
phrases.english: "And he shall come before ה׳ to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting
phrases.notes: ויקרא 15:14. This פסוק is about the זב.

phrases.english: and give them to the kohen."
When does he come?
phrases.notes: The word in square brackets is added in the corrected wording; some versions don't have it.

phrases.aramaic: בִּזְמַן שֶׁהוּא טָבַל וְעָשָׂה הֶעֱרֵב שֶׁמֶשׁ — אִין,
phrases.english: When he has immersed and waited for sunset — yes;

phrases.aramaic: לֹא טָבַל וְעָשָׂה הֶעֱרֵב שֶׁמֶשׁ — לָא.
phrases.english: if he did not immerse and wait for sunset — no.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר אַבָּיֵי: אַשְׁכַּחְתִּינְהוּ לְחַבְרֵיהּ דְּרַב נָתָן בַּר הוֹשַׁעְיָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: After רבא's distinction based on whether the נזיר immersed on the seventh, the גמרא brings a related teaching about when a זב may come with his offerings.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A זב may come to bring his offerings only after he has immersed and waited for sunset.

steps.title: The reason behind the reading: a טבול יום of a זב is like a זב
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא infers that this group holds a זב who immersed but has not yet had sunset is still treated like a real זב.
steps.simpleTranslation: Apparently he holds that a טבול יום of a זב is like a זב.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains the idea behind the teaching it just quoted.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Why may he not come before sunset? Because, in their view, a זב who immersed today but has not yet reached sunset still counts as a זב. So the place where a זב may not enter is also closed to him.

keyTerms.meaning: Someone who immersed today and is waiting for sunset to become fully pure

phrases.english: Apparently he holds

phrases.aramaic: טְבוּל יוֹם שֶׁל זָב — כְּזָב דָּמֵי.
phrases.english: that one who immersed that day from being a zav is like a zav.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Draws out the principle behind the group's reading of the פסוק.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: In this view, a טבול יום of a זב is treated like a full זב until sunset.

steps.title: אביי applies the same reading to the impure נזיר
steps.stepSummary: אביי says to them: by the same logic, the impure נזיר may also come with his offerings only after he immersed and waited for sunset.
steps.simpleTranslation: I said to them: If so, regarding an impure נזיר too, as it is written: "(And he shall bring them) to the כהן, to the entrance of the אהל מועד." When does he come? When he has immersed and waited for sunset.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי pushes the group's reasoning one step further and applies it to the נזיר טמא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק about the impure נזיר uses the same kind of language: he comes to the entrance of the אהל מועד. So if the group reads the זב פסוק as requiring immersion and sunset first, the same reading would have to apply to the נזיר. אביי raises this as a challenge to their reading, and the exchange continues on the next amud.

keyTerms.meaning: But if so; if your logic is right, then...
A נזיר who became impure from a dead body

phrases.english: I said to them:

phrases.aramaic: אֶלָּא מֵעַתָּה גַּבֵּי נָזִיר טָמֵא נָמֵי,
phrases.english: But if so, regarding an impure nazir too,
as it is written: "(And he shall bring them) to the kohen
phrases.notes: במדבר 6:10. Some versions have the words in round brackets, but the corrected wording leaves them out.

phrases.english: to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting."
When does he come?
When he has immersed and waited for sunset.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמֵינָא לְהוֹן אֲנָא: אֶלָּא מֵעַתָּה גַּבֵּי נָזִיר טָמֵא נָמֵי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Takes the group's reading of the זב פסוק and applies the same logic to the impure נזיר.
steps.kashyaTarget: The reading of the group of רב נתן בר הושעיא about the זב
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The same kind of wording appears for the impure נזיר. So if their reading is correct for the זב, it should equally require immersion and sunset before an impure נזיר comes with his offerings. אביי raises this to test their reading.
steps.whatToRemember: אביי argues that if the group's reading is right, both a זב and an impure נזיר could come with their offerings only after immersing and waiting for sunset. This is a challenge to their reading, not a final ruling; the exchange continues on the next amud.
